items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: And then after a while I heard somebody singing the blues, you know, and it sounded like Mamie Smith or one of them.

ctx.x: I didn't know him even, yeah.
Yeah, well, I was surprised. They had his picture there. And Buddy P.T., they knew all about Buddy P.T. and they have Mamie Smith. Oh, go ahead.
They knew something like Buddy P.T. and his stepfather and all?
